translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content: Ber mar dak mobidhore mar rieko

content.text: Wuoda, ka iyie rwako wechena
kendo kano chikena e chunyi;
ka ichiko iti ni weche mag rieko
kendo kiketo chunyi mondo iwinj tiend weche,
to ka imanyo ngʼeyo malingʼ-lingʼ,
kendo ikwayo ngʼeyo tiend wach,
to ka idware ka fedha
kendo imanye ka mwandu mopandi,
eka iniwinj malongʼo tiend luoro Jehova Nyasaye,
kendo iniyud rieko mar ngʼeyo Nyasaye.
Jehova Nyasaye chiwo rieko
kendo ngʼeyo gi winjo aa e dhoge.
Oiko loch ni joma kare,
en okumba ni jogo ma wuodhgi ler,
nimar en okumba mar joma kare
kendo orito yor joge ma jo-adiera.
Ka iwinjo wachna, eka iningʼe gima kare,
kendo mowinjore ma gin yore duto mabeyo.
Nimar rieko nodonj e chunyi,
kendo ngʼeyo nomi ngimani bedo mamor.
Rieko mar pogo tiend wach noriti,
kendo winjo tiend wach nobedni okumba.
Rieko noresi kuom yore mag joma mono,
kuom jogo mawacho weche mochido,
jogo moweyo yore moriere mag bidhruok,
mondo giwuothi e yore mag mudho,
joma mor kuom timo maricho
kendo giil e duwruok mar richo,
jogo ma yoregi ogajore ogajore
kendo gin jowuond e yoregi.
Bende enoresi kuom dhako ma jachode,
kuom dhako mabayo gi wechege maywayo ji,
moseweyo chwore mane okende konyako,
kendo oketho singruok mane otimo e nyim Nyasaye.
Nikech ode tero ji e tho
to yorene tero ji e piny joma otho.
Onge ngʼato madhi ire maduogo
kata yudo yor ngima.
Kuom mano, iniluw yore joma beyo
kendo irit yore joma kare.
Nimar joma kare ema nodag e piny
kendo jogo maonge bura ema nosiki e piny;
to joma timbegi mono nogol oko e piny
kendo jogo ma ok jo-adiera ok nobedie ngangʼ.
